prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the basic modules for Practical Computer Science are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in information management.
Students know the theoretical basics of digital information management as well as selected applications.
Students are able to apply methods from business informatics.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: IT compliance and legal framework of information management

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments. The grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program.
